name: rhf-v8-useform-identity-repro
description: Minimal repro: react-hook-form v8 re-binds getValues/watch/register/getFieldState on every form-state change (and in beta.3 the whole useForm() return value churned), breaking effects keyed on them

scripts.use:v7: npm i --no-save --silent react-hook-form@7.87.0 && npm run -s which
scripts.use:v8: npm i --no-save --silent react-hook-form@8.0.0-beta.4 && npm run -s which
scripts.use:v8beta3: npm i --no-save --silent react-hook-form@8.0.0-beta.3 && npm run -s which
